description: Fix 2 (and the engine/facts side of fix 4): optional generic schema fields + engine/snippet evaluation for deadlines counted from a per-account base (due date field or days-late field, business or calendar days), floors as a percentage of a named account amount field with a rounding mode, per-weekday callback windows, an attempt date rule 'N-th business day after today', plus weekday-name calendar summary / allowed-date lists / one-date cap table in the facts text. Includes the golden backward-compat snapshot taken BEFORE any engine edit. Must go first: FEAT-002..005 read the new variables and functions. Independent of nothing; all later FEATs depend on it.
steps: 1.1 (BEFORE touching builder/): create tests/test_backward_compat.py with build_snapshot() and a `python -m tests.test_backward_compat --write` entry; run it once to write tests/fixtures/golden_facts.json from the UNMODIFIED engine (five fixture specs x synthetic products over every band min/mid/max, every product type, two `now` values; store p<k>_{id,type,name,full,floor,band,deadline,attempts,attemptN_date,attemptN_amount}, business_days, callback_dates, plus check_promise_date / classify_amount / check_callback / aggregate_outcome samples; exclude the text blocks date_facts/product_facts). The test recomputes and compares. Never regenerate the golden file later.

1.2 builder/spec_schema.json + builder/spec.py (+ tests/test_spec.py): add the OPTIONAL fields exactly as in plan section 4 (account_fields.due_date; deadline kinds business_days_after_base / calendar_days_after_base + deadline.base with allOf-required; amounts.floor_percent / floor_default_percent / rounding_mode + $defs/floor_percent_rule; persuasion attempt date_rule business_days_after_today + date_n; callback_window.per_weekday; promise_rules.success_sentence_plural; verbatim_rules[].gap_kind). Add dataclasses (empty/None defaults, omitted on dump) and the semantic_errors listed in section 4. Tests: all new fields validate, round-trip of a spec using ALL new fields (built in the test from spec_brief_ab via deepcopy), parametrized malformed cases per semantic error, and test_old_fixtures_use_no_new_field.

1.3 builder/engine.py: base_date_for, extended deadline_for(band, today, cal, product=None, spec=None) keeping the old kinds byte-identical, product_deadline(product, today, spec, cal=None); floor_for percent sources with the integer-arithmetic rounding (half_up/half_even/up/down, absent mode -> round(x, decimals)) and the precedence floor_fields[type] -> floor_percent[type] -> floor_default_field -> floor_default_percent; _numeric_fields/_coerce include every of_field; callback_window_for(day, spec), check_callback uses it, callback_window_gaps reports malformed per_weekday entries, callback_hours_text(dates, spec); attempt_offer handles business_days_after_today with date_n (still capped by the deadline); calendar_summary(cal) appended to _date_facts; _product_block gets an 'allowed promise dates' line (LISTED_PROMISE_DATES = 15); one_date_table for multi-product cap_each_to_own_deadline with different deadlines. Do not reword existing text lines (tests assert them). Replace every product-aware deadline_for caller with product_deadline: engine.one_date_for_all / attempt_offer / _product_block / compute_facts, selfcheck.facts_expectations + check_promise_dates, online_cases._product_ready/_deadline, online_repair (~line 80). Update selfcheck.make_product / _floor_field_names / types to synthesize due_date (today - days_late) and of_field amounts, and selfcheck.callback_cases to use the effective window of the chosen date.

1.3b builder/snippets.py: ENGINE_SPEC_KEYS['amounts'] gains floor_percent, floor_default_percent, rounding_mode. Add engine tests (base deadlines business/calendar/roll/unresolved; product_deadline == deadline_for_days_late for old kinds; every rounding mode incl. ties; precedence; numeric-string of_field; missing of_field -> None; per-weekday check_callback; attempt rule; calendar_summary for Sunday-Thursday and Monday-Friday calendars; allowed dates; one_date_table; one_date_for_all with account-based deadlines) and extend tests/test_snippets.py so the new-field specs (built in test code from SPEC_AB, neutral values) join the snippet-vs-engine agreement matrix in all four exec modes.

1.4 builder/extract_prompts/sections.md + system.md: instruct the extractor to map each formula to the new structured fields instead of prose, and to set verbatim_rules[].gap_kind when a rule of those kinds cannot be mapped (generic examples only, no brief values). Add a tests/test_extract.py assertion on the loaded prompt text. Optionally ground account_fields.due_date and floor_percent.*.of_field against openapi_field_names in builder/extract.py if it is a small change.
Run uv run python scripts/check_contamination.py after each sub-step; fix wording, never the allowlist.
acceptance_criteria: uv run pytest -q passes with >= 679 tests, 0 failures, and tests/test_backward_compat.py proves identical structured facts for the five fixtures.
spec_brief_a, spec_brief_ab and spec_variant_1..3 still validate (`uv run python -m builder.spec validate` prints OK) and round-trip unchanged.
A spec using every new field validates, round-trips and yields engine results identical to the snippet (agreement tests, all four exec modes).
Percent floors are exact in integer arithmetic for every rounding mode; unresolved base/of_field gives None/unknown, never a fallback value.
uv run python scripts/check_contamination.py reports 0 strict hits and 0 allowlist problems.
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_backward_compat.py tests/test_spec.py tests/test_task9_variants.py tests/test_engine.py tests/test_snippets.py tests/test_selfcheck.py tests/test_online_cases.py tests/test_online_repair.py tests/test_extract.py
for f in spec_brief_a spec_brief_ab spec_variant_1 spec_variant_2 spec_variant_3; do uv run python -m builder.spec validate tests/fixtures/$f.json; done
findings: FEAT-001 done, nothing committed. pytest 799 passed (was 679); contamination 0 hits; all 5 fixtures validate. Per user, testing kept light. Golden: tests/test_backward_compat.py (build_snapshot, --write) + tests/fixtures/golden_facts.json written from the unmodified engine; never regenerate. Schema/spec.py: all optional fields from plan s4 + semantic errors (base required/only with *_after_base, due_date_field needs account_fields.due_date, days_late_field needs days_late, date_n required/only with business_days_after_today, per_weekday duplicate weekday and hour_end before hour_start). Dataclasses: AccountFields.due_date, Deadline.base, FloorPercentRule, Amounts.floor_percent/floor_default_percent/rounding_mode, Attempt.date_n, PerWeekdayWindow, CallbackWindow.per_weekday, PromiseRules.success_sentence_plural, VerbatimRule.gap_kind. Engine new API: base_date_for(deadline_cfg, product, today, spec); deadline_for(band, today, cal, product=None, spec=None); product_deadline(product, today, spec, cal=None); _percent_floor(product, rule, spec); floor_for precedence floor_fields->floor_percent->floor_default_field->floor_default_percent (a configured source with missing input gives None, no fall-through); callback_window_for(day, spec) (per_weekday entry without 'inclusive' inherits the single window's value); callback_hours_text(dates, spec) (lines joined by newline, format '<Weekday> <iso>: HH:MM to HH:MM (both included|end excluded)'); callback_window_gaps now also returns 'per_weekday' / 'per_weekday[i].hours'; calendar_summary(cal) appended as last line of date_facts; product_facts has '- allowed promise dates (...)' line after 'latest promise date' (LISTED_PROMISE_DATES=15, then ', ... last: <label>'); one_date_table(products, today, spec, cal) appended as last block of product_facts (only for cap_each_to_own_deadline with >=2 different deadlines). For per_weekday specs date_facts prints 'Callback dates allowed: ...; the hours depend on the date:' followed by callback_hours_text lines. No new output variable names (output_names unchanged), so FEAT-002 can read callback hours via engine.callback_window_for / callback_hours_text. Callers switched to product_deadline: engine (one_date_for_all, attempt_offer, _product_block, compute_facts), online_cases (_product_ready/_deadline), online_repair, selfcheck (facts_expectations, check_promise_dates). selfcheck.make_product synthesizes due_date (today - days_late) and of_field amounts (FULL_AMOUNT); self.types includes floor_percent keys; callback_cases uses engine.callback_window_for(last). snippets.ENGINE_SPEC_KEYS['amounts'] gained floor_percent, floor_default_percent, rounding_mode. Prompts: sections.md and system.md instruct mapping to the new fields and gap_kind; tests/test_extract.py asserts keywords. Skipped by design (lighter testing): per-error parametrized coverage is included for spec, but openapi grounding of due_date/of_field in extract.py was NOT done (optional). Surprises: a deadline in the past (account-based) makes one_date_table cap to a past date; selfcheck's promise checks still test the OLD clamp hook semantics (FEAT-002 rewrites them). Test counts: test_spec +~30, test_engine +~55, test_snippets +10, test_backward_compat 12, test_extract +1.
